title: Gratin Aubergine with Peruvian Crunch
description: A flavorful vegetarian dish combining the richness of gratin with the crunch of peruvian corn. Aubergine is the star of the show in this easy-to-make recipe.
instructions: Slice the aubergine into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the sliced aubergine to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the cooked aubergine to a baking dish.
Spread the gratin over the aubergine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the gratin is golden brown.
